about_the_game:
Destroy the cubes. Expand the field. Upgrade++.

Cube-Field+: is a fast-paced, endless runner that puts your reflexes to the test in a third dimensional cube centric world. Inspired by the classic browser game, this reimagined version takes things to a whole new level with modern visuals, tight controls, and incremental gameplay features.

Steer your tetrahedron through the ever tightening field of cubes. Challenging your precision, timing, and focus. But death isn't the end, it's just another step towards mastery.

Features:

  • Endless Runner, Infinite Challenge
    No two runs are the same. Procedurally generated cube fields and dynamic speed scaling with leaderboards.

  • Incremental Progression
    Upgrade your vessel's firepower, abilities and material acquisition . The further you go, the more resources you earn to enhance future runs.

  • Stylized Minimalism
    Clean retro visuals and a pulsing electronic soundtrack.

  • Demo does not include all features, late game features are cut off. Including Roguelike mode with leaderboards.

You Will Crash.

You Will Retry.
You Will Transcend Speed.

short_description: Inspired by the classic browser game. Race through a 3D field of cubes in Cube-Field+, a fast-paced endless runner with incremental mechanics. Upgrade your vessel, unlock powerful abilities, and push further with each run in a hypnotic loop of speed, precision, and progress.
